title: Super Fast: Pumpkin Ravioli with Mushy Peas
subtitle: On the table in under 20 minutes!
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our 'super-fast' recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the peas (see Kitchen notes). Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the ravioli. Quarter the zucchini lengthwise and cut into 1.5cm chunks. Thinly slice the spring onions.
Make mushy peas: Add the peas to the small pan of boiling water and cook for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then return to the pan. Add 10g plant-based butter, season with salt and coarsely mash.

Cook sauce base: While the peas are cooking, put the walnuts in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in the pan over high heat. Cook the zucchini and spring onion, stirring occasionally, for 2 mins or until slightly softened.
Cook ravioli: Meanwhile, cook the ravioli in the remaining pan of boiling water for 3 mins or until al dente. Reserve 125ml (½ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta.

Serve up: Add the ravioli, peas and pepper and garlic seasoning to the zucchini mixture. Increase the heat to high. Gradually add the reserved cooking water (see Kitchen notes), stirring constantly, until the sauce coats the pasta and looks slightly glossy. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the ravioli among bowls, scatter with the walnuts and enjoy!
Kitchen notes: Speed things up by using your kettle to boil the water. ~ Adding the starchy pasta cooking water helps emulsify the sauce so that it binds and coats the pasta.
